verdict.rationale: Conta Simples' marketing site lists an "Área de aprovações" (approvals area) alongside batch payments, boletos and Pix, so the product does have its own approval workflow. Nothing in the evidence describes how it works, so the multi-step, delegation and escalation parts of the story are unproven. User access profiles are an adjacent permissions feature and do not count toward approval chains. Missing for 10: documented multi-step approval chains (manager → budget owner → finance), approver delegation, escalation or timeouts when approvers sit on requests, API or docs coverage of approvals, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
